selections.description: Adapt shared Spectrum public call shapes, content builders and cloud iMessage consumption without transplanting the generalized provider framework.
acceptance: Supported Spectrum factory, imessage selectors/configuration, user/space lookup, send/reply variadics, actions and stop preserve upstream names and signatures; existing createSpectrum/app APIs remain usable through public exports.

Static and async builders preserve validation, order and target identities. Module-scope construction is lazy and workerd-safe; raw binary values stay Uint8Array and Web attachments remain app-owned and cancelable.

Evaluate text streams/extractors, Markdown/fallback, app/poll/membership/avatar/contact/voice/effect builders against original source and tests. Implement meaningful supported Web behavior with regression tests; report a precise macOS, dependency, provider or pinned-wire-contract blocker rather than inventing RPCs or silently claiming parity.

responding preserves callback result/error, attempts typing stop in finally and tolerates stop failure. Canonical target-space/phone guards and multipart child identities survive every action builder.

Public umbrella/provider exports retain identity with independently usable api, webhooks and imessage packages; compile and execute supported public consumption in packed workerd tests without Node compatibility flags.

Every adopted scenario has executable assertions and docs/ports receipts with immutable upstream source/test links, SHA-256 of original bytes, mapped target tests, adaptations and unresolved cases. Test counts, skipped placeholders and reports alone are not behavioral evidence.

instructions.goal: Make this default policy independently useful for actual public API and builder implementation, with original upstream tests as evidence, not a documentation-only compatibility report.
adaptation: Read docs/UPSTREAM-COMPATIBILITY.md and docs/COMPATIBILITY-PLAN.md before changing ownership. Extend the existing facade, content resolver and public indexes; share the existing SpectrumLines inventory, native materializer and app lifetime.

The immutable baseline acknowledges only a partial existing port, not parity. Full adoption must evaluate missing selected capabilities and produce concrete behavior/tests or an honest blocked decision.

Upstream utility/platform/authoring files and test-support are dependency and semantic evidence, not permission to recreate arbitrary provider loading, private context mocks, filesystem tooling or Node transports.

Manifests are protected. If new dependencies, packages or export-map entries are necessary, record an architecture decision in docs/ports and request a separately reviewed policy change; do not weaken the checks or substitute a fake implementation.
nonGoals: Other-provider machinery, local Apple databases/macOS implementation, environment discovery and wholesale upstream framework transplantation.
Automatic telemetry, Node/Bun polyfills, Buffer, nodejs_compat, generated emoji inventory copying or Node audio/image subprocesses.

preserve: Update current usage and compatibility documentation when behavior changes, while retaining original test attribution, license notices and historical baseline coverage. New support is not evidence that old tests were rebased.

Preserve all existing SDK work, public names/signatures and standalone package ownership. Use only standard Web APIs and the existing binary gRPC-Web and management contracts; no Node/Bun runtime dependencies or invented wire operations.

Keep one SpectrumLines inventory and one app lifetime. getMessage remains authoritative native lookup, not cache-first. Preserve canonical phone/space guards, multipart identities, awaited authenticated webhook handlers and bounded lazy error/cancel-safe iteration.

Original tests remain meaningful and new regressions are allowed; never delete, skip, relax or replace assertions merely to pass verification. Do not alter protected boundary/provenance/audit checks indirectly via fixtures or production special cases.

Keep tests/upstream-manifest.json and its original immutable pins unchanged. Record future partial-port links/hashes and adaptations separately under docs/ports with executable tests; never relabel local tests as original upstream files or claim test-count parity.
Do not change package manifests, lockfiles, scripts, CI, policy/check runners or source-audit logic. New dependency/package/export decisions require explicit human approval outside this policy.
